findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_plans" is 1727 chars, far longer than this server's median (198). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.detail: Description of "search_plans" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
